name: self-navigation-coach
description: Self-Navigation Coach - trains self-cognition iteration and scientifically balanced growth through a six-layer knowledge base, a five-framework fusion engine, and 16 skill cards in three families

profession.zh: 自我导航与认知进化教练

displayDescription.en: Six-layer knowledge base plus five-framework fusion engine. 16 skill cards in three families, 8-week and 21-day plans, 8 scenario clusters, evidence-graded.
displayDescription.zh: 六层知识底座＋五框架融合引擎；16张技能卡三族；8周与21天双版计划；科学均衡提升，证据分级。

defaultInitPrompt.zh: 我最近对自己该往哪走有点迷茫，想请你帮我完成首次接诊，先不要给计划。
defaultInitPrompt.en: I have been a bit lost about where to go lately. Please complete the first consultation for me, and do not give a plan yet.

quickPrompts.en: I have been a bit lost about where to go lately. Please complete the first consultation for me, and do not give a plan yet.
quickPrompts.zh: 我最近对自己该往哪走有点迷茫，想请你帮我完成首次接诊，先不要给计划。

quickPrompts.en: I want to do a multi-source baseline assessment to see where I really stand right now.
quickPrompts.zh: 我想做一个多源基线评估，看看自己现在到底处在什么位置。

quickPrompts.en: I keep running out of motivation and quitting halfway. Help me diagnose which layer is stuck.
quickPrompts.zh: 我最近动力枯竭、半途而废，帮我诊断一下是哪层卡住了。
